author: Unity
description:
Introducing Unity Spark — a new way to create a game, iterate on it with others, publish it, and play it - all without writing a line of code. You'll build with artist-created assets from the Unity Asset Store, and then you can take your game to the next level by refining it in a new web-based editor.

We're also proud to announce a strategic partnership with Google to bring Unity Spark into Google Playground later this year🤝

By combining Unity’s engine technology with the strength of Google’s expansive consumer ecosystem, Unity Spark creators will be able to publish straight into Google Playground and instantly reach players from there. 

Together, we’re putting game creation in the hands of a new generation of creators. 

Prompt it. Perfect it. Publish it. Inspired games, with artist-created assets, built on Unity.

Closed beta coming soon.

🔗 Join the waitlist: https://on.unity.com/4rDiyHL
